Exact feedback release

/teach/courses/:courseId/releases
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S20

Release an explicitly reviewed, immutable per-learner feedback payload while holding incomplete or changed records.

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Release exact feedback
  • Recipient count, sample learner payload, exceptions, quiz key visibility and snapshot fingerprint
  • Graded does not mean released; delivery outcome is separate
Return without applying changesRelease reviewed snapshot
Permissions
  • Instructor alone prepares and confirms release; TA may see own completion status but cannot open bulk release payloads.
  • Each learner later opens only their own released snapshot, never peers' results or held revisions.
Responsive
  • Use labelled sequential steps; narrow web previews one recipient at a time with selected count and exclusions persistent.
  • Do not hide old/new result differences behind a release button; stale status and final acknowledgment remain next to confirmation.
Accessibility
  • Announce step changes and stale-preview errors; validation returns focus to the changed recipient or acknowledgment.
  • Preview tables name learner, score, receipt and version. Final dialog states recipients/content and restores focus; confirmation cannot depend on colour or a visual checkbox alone.
Data
  • Instructor-only fingerprint binds candidate kind,exact recipients,payload,policy version,actual attempt/receipt and rubric when applicable,and captured membership where relevant.
  • Release snapshots are immutable; operation ID supports uncertain-outcome checks. Notification delivery is separate. TA receives completion status, never bulk release payloads.
  • Discriminated release candidate: reviewed_attempt, status_outcome or policy_projection. Receipt required only for reviewed_attempt; policy projection binds only released item/status snapshots and policy version.
Acceptance checks (6)
  • A comment edit after preview blocks release even if scores did not change.
  • Group receipt produces member-specific result snapshots with common work and explicit overrides.
  • Release failure/uncertain outcome offers status check by operation ID and never creates duplicate snapshots on retry.
  • Publish a new policy-only course-total projection without a new score or receipt; stale score/policy changes invalidate its preview.
  • Release Missing/Excused outcomes without a fabricated submission or completed numeric review; student W24 sees the approved status/denominator only after release.
  • A course-wide policy release navigates without an assessmentId; Nothing ready appears only when all three candidate kinds are ineligible.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
